Frequently asked questions

FAQs

Common questions users may have when beginning to explore residency pathways.

Where should I start?

Start by choosing the section that best matches your situation: Student, Worker or Family. Then use the pathway guide and check the official Immigration New Zealand requirements.

Are the requirements the same for everyone?

No. Requirements depend on the specific visa or residence pathway and the applicant's circumstances. Always check the current official requirements.

What documents might I need?

Documents vary by pathway. They may include identity, travel, study, employment, qualification or relationship evidence. The relevant official INZ page should be checked for the complete list.

Can I rely only on this website?

No. This website is designed as a navigation and information guide. Immigration New Zealand should be used to confirm current requirements before applying.

Why are official links included?

Visa and residency requirements can change. Linking users to official Immigration New Zealand information helps them verify the latest requirements.

About the outcome

Your journey, our guide.

This digital outcome is designed around the stakeholder need for clear, updated, accurate and simple information about New Zealand residency pathways.

Why this website is useful

The website organises information by user type, uses simple headings and provides step-by-step pathway guides. This helps users locate relevant information without having to search through one long page.

It also provides official links so users can verify important information.

Accessibility & usability

  • Consistent navigation throughout the website.
  • Simple language and clear headings.
  • High-contrast text and buttons.
  • Responsive layout for smaller screens.
  • Information divided into manageable sections.
